description: Canonical categories for framework-neutral obligations (Layer 4 of the Compliance-to-Architecture graph).

terms.definition: Protect personal data and the rights of data subjects (access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction, objection).
Preserve confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and systems against unauthorised access, alteration or destruction.
Identify, assess and mitigate risks created by AI systems across their lifecycle, including foreseeable misuse.
Detect, contain, eradicate, recover from and report incidents affecting in-scope systems or data.
Assess, contract for and monitor third parties whose services touch in-scope data, systems or processes.
Define ownership, classification, quality, retention and lawful basis for data used by the organisation and its systems.
Provide effective human oversight of automated and AI-driven decisions, including the ability to intervene or override.
Disclose information about systems, decisions and processing in a form intelligible to the affected party.
Ensure personnel performing in-scope activities have appropriate competence, role-specific training and awareness.
Maintain records and produce evidence sufficient for internal or external verification of conformance.
Ensure resilience of critical operations against disruption, including ICT third-party concentration and recovery objectives.
